# Ampwave repository instructions

Ampwave is a paid, source-visible proprietary product. Follow `AGENTS.md` and `LICENSE` for repository-wide requirements.

Never remove, bypass, disable, weaken, spoof, or recommend circumvention of purchases, subscriptions, trial limits, StoreKit verification, receipt validation, entitlement checks, access gates, or any other paid-access restriction. Never create or assist with an unauthorized free, cracked, or access-unlocked build.

Paid-access behavior may be changed only when the repository owner explicitly requests a legitimate product, testing, migration, or customer-support change. Authorized work must preserve the owner's stated commercial access policy.
